note: Neutral starter library: the phases, exercises and events an EBT / LPC / OPC program is expected to contain under ICAO Doc 9995 (EBT Manual), ICAO PANS-TRG, EASA ORO.FC.231 and EASA Part-FCL Appendix 9. Nothing here comes from any operator's document. An operator adds its own from the builder.

elements.title: Session briefing
elements.text: Threat and error management framing, the session's training elements, the competencies in focus, charts and performance.

elements.title: Facilitated debriefing
elements.text: Facilitated debrief led by the crew's own analysis; observable behaviours below standard and the root cause.

elements.title: Line-oriented flight (LOFT)
elements.text: A complete sector flown as on the line, with threats and errors representative of the operation. Evaluation phase.

elements.title: Rejected take-off
elements.text: Rejected take-off at high speed for a reason that requires a stop.

elements.title: Engine failure after V1
elements.text: Engine failure between V1 and V2; continue the take-off, secure the engine.

elements.title: One-engine-inoperative approach and go-around
elements.text: Approach with one engine inoperative, go-around from minima, second approach and landing.

elements.title: One-engine-inoperative landing
elements.text: Manual approach and landing with one engine inoperative.

elements.title: Low-visibility approach (CAT II / III)
elements.text: Automatic approach and landing in low visibility; a failure at or below the alert height at the instructor's discretion.

elements.title: Raw-data ILS, manual flight
elements.text: ILS flown manually without flight director, with a go-around.

elements.title: Non-precision approach
elements.text: RNP or conventional non-precision approach to minima.

elements.title: Circling approach
elements.text: Circling approach and landing, or go-around from the circling manoeuvre.

elements.title: Crosswind take-off and landing
elements.text: Take-off and landing at the demonstrated crosswind, dry and contaminated runway.

elements.title: Upset prevention and recovery
elements.text: Recognition and recovery from nose-high and nose-low upsets, per the manufacturer's UPRT guidance.

elements.title: Approach to stall and recovery
elements.text: Approach to stall in clean and landing configurations, recovery at the first indication.

elements.title: TCAS resolution advisory
elements.text: Traffic conflict resolving in an RA; manual response and return to the clearance.

elements.title: Windshear escape
elements.text: Predictive and reactive windshear on take-off or approach; escape manoeuvre.

elements.title: EGPWS terrain escape
elements.text: Terrain warning and the escape manoeuvre.

elements.title: Emergency descent
elements.text: Rapid decompression at cruise altitude and the emergency descent.

elements.title: Smoke, fire or fumes
elements.text: Smoke or fire in the cabin, cargo or avionics; diversion decision.

elements.title: Hydraulic system failure
elements.text: Loss of one or two hydraulic systems; degraded controls and landing.

elements.title: Electrical failure
elements.text: Loss of generators or an emergency electrical configuration.

elements.title: Fuel leak
elements.text: Fuel leak detection, the leak procedure, diversion.

elements.title: Unreliable airspeed
elements.text: Unreliable airspeed indication; memory items, pitch and thrust.

elements.title: Degraded flight control law
elements.text: Alternate or direct law handling and approach.

elements.title: Go-around, all engines
elements.text: Go-around from minima and from below minima, all engines operating.

elements.title: Runway incursion prevention, taxi
elements.text: Taxi with re-clearances and runway crossings; clearance verification and STOP - CLARIFY - VERIFY.

elements.title: Cold-weather operations
elements.text: De-icing coordination, holdover time, contaminated runway performance.

elements.title: Additional training
elements.text: Repetition of what was observed during the session - the manoeuvre or behaviour the crew or the instructor identified. Time as observed.

elements.title: TCAS traffic advisory
elements.text: Traffic ahead, single threat, while the crew is busy.

elements.title: TCAS resolution advisory
elements.text: Traffic conflict resolving in an RA.

elements.title: Windshear on approach
elements.text: Reactive windshear warning below 1 000 ft.

elements.title: Windshear after take-off
elements.text: Windshear warning after rotation.

elements.title: Weather deteriorates below minima
elements.text: Visibility or ceiling drops below minima during the approach.

elements.title: Crosswind increases
elements.text: Wind change raises the crosswind component on final.

elements.title: ATC re-clearance
elements.text: Runway or routing change late in the approach or taxi.

elements.title: ATC speed constraint
elements.text: A speed to be kept until a distance from touchdown.

elements.title: Breakout instruction
elements.text: Traffic alert with an immediate turn and climb or descent.

elements.title: Cabin crew report
elements.text: A report from the cabin that needs a decision.

elements.title: Ground crew interruption
elements.text: Refuelling, maintenance or loading contacts the cockpit during preparation.

elements.title: Conflicting traffic on departure
elements.text: Traffic descending into the departure airport during the climb.

elements.title: Bird strike reported
elements.text: A passenger or the cabin crew reports a bird into an engine.

elements.title: Runway closed
elements.text: The planned runway closes; a different departure or arrival runway.
